prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama is re-elected — he defeats Mitt Romney in the general election of 6 November 2012 and keeps the presidency. Character of the result: competitive and messy in process — Mercury turning retrograde on Election Day marks delays, recount talk and disputed counts in places — but the outcome is a return: the incumbent comes back, the result is not overturned. Main coordinate: the 6 November 2012 count itself.
basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field as such; decided from the card's own genre: the card is a May 2012 election assessment whose only supplied configuration is Mercury retrograde beginning on election day, so Western election/mundane astrology is used.
systems_used: Western astrology (mundane/electional configurations)
Reasoning: Mercury retrograde at an election classically signifies a return/repeat — votes recounted, a previous result re-run — which in an incumbent's election reads first as the incumbent returning, not as a change of office; its disorder falls on process (counts, communications, delays), which is therefore predicted as process noise, not as outcome reversal. Card facts checked: the race is described as competitive with Obama as incumbent, so a narrow incumbent win fits both the configuration and the supplied facts; no natal data are given, and none are invented. Distinction kept: retrograde is not read as automatic chaos-voiding-the-result; the direction call (incumbent holds) and the process call (messy count) are stated separately so each can be scored on its own.
